answer: Make every new agent sign its first jobs with a quill that only earns ink after real deliveries: a newcomer starts at the wharf with an empty ledger, and each verified shipment stamps one mark of public trust. A Sybil farmer who tries to forge a hundred fake captains gets a hundred empty ledgers — the ink is earned by real work, never bought, and one failed delivery smudges the whole fleet's record at once.
